sentences.en: Um, well, a couple of quick questions.
sentences.zh: 嗯，几个简短的问题。

sentences.en: Any idea of a year, roughly?
sentences.zh: 大致知道是哪一年吗？

sentences.en: Kind of, maybe, well, no.
sentences.zh: 差不多，也许吧，嗯，不知道。

sentences.en: I mean, sometime between 4 BC and 88.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在公元前4年到公元8年之间某个时候。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And Joseph and Mary, any reason to doubt that they're the names of Jesus's parents?
sentences.zh: 那么关于约瑟和玛利亚，有什么理由怀疑这就是耶稣父母的名字吗？

sentences.en: Don't think so.
sentences.zh: 觉得没有。

sentences.en: So don't think so, as in, we may as well just take them on truSt. Yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以觉得没有的意思是，我们大可以直接把这当成事实接受下来。是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So once Luke, so go back to Luke's gospel, once he's done the nativity, the next chapter, so chapter three, he gets into the, back into a little bit of history, which I like,
sentences.zh: 那么一旦路加——回到路加福音——一旦他写完了耶稣降生，下一章，也就是第三章，他又回到了我喜欢的一点历史叙事中，

sentences.en: the 15th year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea and Herod being
sentences.zh: “该撒提庇里奴作王十五年，本丢彼拉多作犹太抚台，希律作加利利分封王……”诸如此类。

sentences.en: Tetrarch Galilee, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah.
sentences.zh: 亚那和该亚法担任大祭司。

sentences.en: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests.
sentences.zh: 神的话临到旷野中撒迦利亚的儿子约翰。

sentences.zh: 这就是施洗

sentences.en: This is John the
sentences.zh: 约翰。

sentences.en: BaptiSt. And he came into all the country about the river Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.
sentences.zh: 他来到约旦河一带地方，宣讲悔改的洗礼，使罪得赦。

sentences.en: So now we've moved on in the story to a different character, which is John the Baptist, who is, do you know what?
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们的故事推进到了一个不同的角色，也就是施洗约翰，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I've actually, I'm actually quite hazy about John the BaptiSt. He is the forerunner of Jesus.
sentences.zh: 其实我……我对施洗约翰其实挺模糊的。他是耶稣的先驱。

sentences.en: He's going around saying, you know, he's a sort of eschatological apocalyptic prophet is he?
sentences.zh: 他到处对人说……他算是一种末世论的 apocalyptic 先知吗？

sentences.en: Is that what he's about?
sentences.zh: 他是这样的人吗？

sentences.en: Yes, which we should probably explain.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们可能需要解释一下。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a lot of syllables there.
sentences.zh: 对，里面有很多音节。

sentences.en: So basically he is, he's preaching repentance.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上他在，他在宣讲悔改。

sentences.en: He's saying that the day of judgment is coming.
sentences.zh: 他在说审判日就要来临了。

sentences.en: He compares the coming day of judgment to the cutting down of a fruitless tree.
sentences.zh: 他将即将到来的审判日比作砍伐一棵不结果子的树。

sentences.en: And this is an image that Jesus himself will then repeat.
sentences.zh: 而这个意象耶稣本人后来也会重复。

sentences.en: You know, it's a very unusual image.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一个非常不寻常的意象。

sentences.en: It's not something that you get elsewhere in scripture.
sentences.zh: 这不是你在其他经文里能看到的。

sentences.en: So that does suggest that it's, it's John's and then Jesus picks it up.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实表明，这是，这是约翰的，然后耶稣拾起了它。

sentences.en: And this is why most scholars, I mean, even the most skeptical would accept that Jesus was crucified and they would accept that, that Jesus was baptized by
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么大多数学者，我是说，即使是最怀疑的人也会接受耶稣被钉死在十字架上，他们也会接受，耶稣曾受洗于

sentences.en: John because it's a source of some embarrassment because it implies if John is washing people clean so that they're ready for the day of judgment, then it implies that Jesus needs
sentences.zh: 约翰，因为这是一个有些尴尬的来源，因为它暗示如果约翰在为人洗净让他们为审判日做好准备，这就暗示了耶稣需要

sentences.en: to be washed clean.
sentences.zh: 被洗净。

sentences.en: And there's a bit of kind of, you know, there's a bit of skirting around that issue in the gospels or kind of reframing of it.
sentences.zh: 并且福音书中对这个问题有点，你知道的，有点避而不谈或重新构建。

sentences.en: So John is a kind of holy man, kind of wandering the wilderness, preaching to people and washing them.
sentences.zh: 所以约翰是一个圣人般的人物，有点像在旷野中游荡，向人们讲道并为他们施洗。

sentences.en: And I would guess, I mean, I'm not an expert on the first century AD or the first century BC by any means, but I'm guessing there are lots of people like John in this world.
sentences.zh: 我想，我是说，我绝不是公元一世纪或公元前一世纪的专家，但我猜这个世界上有很多像约翰这样的人。

sentences.en: There are quite a lot, but he is remembered as a significant figure.
sentences.zh: 确实有不少，但他作为一位重要人物而被人们铭记。

sentences.en: So he's mentioned by
sentences.zh: 所以他被

sentences.en: Josephus, talked about that in the last episode, and he comes to a kind of grisly end.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫斯提及，上一集讨论过，他迎来了某种惨淡的结局。

sentences.en: He gets put to death by Herod Antipas as a troublemaker.
sentences.zh: 他作为一名滋事者被希律·安提帕处决了。

sentences.en: And the story that gets told about him is that, you know, John the Baptist's head gets chopped up because Salome, Herod's daughter, does this
sentences.zh: 关于他的传说说，你知道的，施洗约翰的头被砍掉了，因为希律的女儿萨洛梅跳了这段

sentences.en: erotic dance and all that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 艳舞以及诸如此类的东西。

sentences.en: I mean, that is, I think, perhaps a slight novelization of what happened, but I think there's no doubt because both Josephus says it and it seems to be
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这或许是对发生的事情的一种轻微的小说化，但我认为毫无疑问，因为约瑟夫斯这样说过，而且在福音书中似乎被

sentences.en: taken for granted in the Gospels, that John the Baptist is put to death by Herod Antipas and that
sentences.zh: 视为理所当然，施洗约翰是被希律·安提帕处死的，并且

sentences.en: this upsets Jesus, that Jesus is either a follower or in the Gospels he's his cousin, that
sentences.zh: 这让耶稣很不高兴，耶稣要么是追随者，要么在福音书中他是他的表弟，所以

sentences.en: so far as we can tell from the Gospels, Jesus seems to have regarded Antipas with a peculiar contempt because of this.
sentences.zh: 据我们从福音书中所能了解到的，因为这件事，耶稣似乎对安提帕怀有一种奇特的蔑视。

sentences.en: So he's very, there's no reason to doubt, I guess, the carpentry, is there?
sentences.zh: 所以他很，没有理由怀疑木匠这个身份，对吧？

sentences.en: That they are from a carpentry family, his father's a carpenter, there's no reason to doubt that he's a carpenter.
sentences.zh: 他们来自一个木匠家庭，他父亲是个木匠，没有理由怀疑他是个木匠。

sentences.en: So he's a workman of some kind, but not the poorest of the poor by any means.
sentences.zh: 所以他是某种体力劳动者，但绝对不是赤贫之辈。

sentences.en: No, but not the richest of the rich either.
sentences.zh: 是的，但也绝不是最富有的人。

sentences.en: So a skilled artisan, skilled artisan background.
sentences.zh: 所以是一个熟练工匠，熟练工匠的背景。

sentences.en: And that he, now I'm trying to approach this with, as a very much 20th century historian, that John the Baptist is a, to use modern terminology, the leader of a kind of cult,
sentences.zh: 而且他，现在我正试图以一个十足的二十世纪历史学家的态度来对待这一点，即施洗约翰是，用现代术语来说，某种邪教的领袖，

sentences.en: a baptism cult, that Jesus is his relative or his follower who has been attracted to this,
sentences.zh: 一个施洗邪教，耶稣是他的亲戚或追随者，被吸引到了这个组织，

sentences.en: and then having been received into the cult is then very put out when the leader is executed as a troublemaker.
sentences.zh: 然后在被这个邪教接纳之后，当这位领袖作为滋事者被处决时，他感到非常恼火。

sentences.en: No, I think Jesus is much more independent than that.
sentences.zh: 不，我认为耶稣要独立得多。

sentences.en: I think that he gets inspiration perhaps from John.
sentences.zh: 我认为他或许从约翰那里得到了灵感。

sentences.en: I mean, he clearly comes to John, he learns from John.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他显然来到了约翰这里，他向约翰学习。

sentences.en: But the thing that is manifest in the gospels, and as far as we can tell, is something that is taken for granted
sentences.zh: 但福音书中明显表现出来的事情，据我们所能了解的，是每一个成为基督徒的人都视为理所当然的事，

sentences.en: by everybody who becomes a Christian, as early as back as we can trace the evidence, is that Jesus has, to put it mildly, a very elevated sense of his role.
sentences.zh: 追溯到我们能追踪到的最早证据，那就是耶稣对自己的角色有着，委婉地说，非常崇高的认识。

sentences.en: So he is making incredible claims about himself.
sentences.zh: 所以他对自己作出了令人难以置信的宣称。

sentences.en: But he's not claiming, am I right in thinking, Tom, that he is not explicitly claiming to be the son of God.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有宣称——我这样想对吗，汤姆——他并没有明确宣称自己是上帝的儿子。

sentences.en: That's not something he goes around saying.
sentences.zh: 这不是他到处宣扬的事情。

sentences.en: I think it's not clear.
sentences.zh: 我认为这一点并不明确。

sentences.en: One of the telling things in the gospels, I think, is that
sentences.zh: 我认为福音书中最说明问题的事情之一是，

sentences.en: Jesus is in his parables and so on, where he portrays kings seem to be allying the role of the king with himself rather than with God the Father, if you want to put it like that.
sentences.zh: 耶稣在他的比喻等内容中，描绘君王时似乎是将君王的角色与他自己联系在一起，而不是与圣父上帝联系在一起，如果你想这么说的话。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And he's preaching the coming of the kingdom of God, and we'll perhaps come on to what he means by the kingdom of God.
sentences.zh: 他在宣讲上帝之国的降临，我们或许会接着探讨他所说的上帝之国是什么意思。

sentences.en: But he is, I mean, I think that he is claiming quite high things for himself, because I think otherwise it's impossible to explain why his followers come to assume
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，我认为他为自己提出了相当高的主张，因为我认为否则就无法解释为什么他的追随者会开始假设

sentences.en: these things about him.
sentences.zh: 关于他的这些事情。

sentences.en: So I guess two really salient pieces of evidence for that would be that he summons, according to the gospels, 12 followers, 12 disciples, and these approximate to the 12 tribes
sentences.zh: 所以我想对此真正突出的两个证据是，根据福音书，他召集了12个追随者，12个门徒，这些大致对应于以色列的

sentences.en: of Israel.
sentences.zh: 12个支派。

sentences.en: And the 12 tribes of Israel will be gathered at the end of days by God.
sentences.zh: 而以色列的12个支派将在末日由上帝聚集。

sentences.en: So this seems to be what Jesus is doing.
sentences.zh: 所以这似乎就是耶稣在做的事情。

sentences.en: And the other thing is that Jesus is executed for claiming to be king of the Judeans.
sentences.zh: 另一件事是，耶稣因为自称是犹太人之王而被处死。

sentences.en: He is claiming a kingly role.
sentences.zh: 他在宣称君王的角色。

sentences.en: Now, whether that is as God's deputy, whether in some way it's coterminous with God's rule, impossible to say.
sentences.zh: 至于这是否作为上帝的副手，是否在某种程度上与上帝的统治并存，这无从说起。

sentences.en: But the seeds of what will become the Christian understanding of Jesus' role, I think, from the evidence of the gospels, and from the evidence of
sentences.zh: 但将成为基督教对耶稣角色理解的萌芽，我认为，从福音书的证据以及

sentences.en: Paul's letters, and the trace elements of pre-Pauline teachings within Paul's letters, seem to derive from Jesus himself.
sentences.zh: 保罗书信的证据，以及保罗书信中前保罗时期教义的残余成分来看，似乎都源自耶稣本人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I think that this is a kind of, this was very much not the consensus, say, in the 70s.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一种，这在70年代绝不是共识。

sentences.en: And I think now it is much more the consensus.
sentences.zh: 而现在我认为这更加成为了共识。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So it's something probably that Bart Ehrman, who is very sceptical in general about what we can learn
sentences.zh: 所以这大概是巴特·埃尔曼——他对我们能从福音书中了解到的东西

sentences.en: from the gospels, I mean, he basically accepts that this very, very early understanding of Jesus' elevated role is there pretty much from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 普遍持非常怀疑的态度——基本上也接受的观点，即这种关于耶稣崇高角色的极早期的理解几乎从一开始就存在。

sentences.en: But to go back to Jesus the man, I mean, he lives for, till his early, till 30s, early 30s, mid 30s, I'm guessing, or late 20s, maybe.
sentences.zh: 但回到耶稣这个人，我的意思是，他活到了，到他三十岁左右，三十岁出头，三十岁中期，我猜，或者二十岁末，也许吧。

sentences.en: He, for most of that time, he's not doing anything.
sentences.zh: 他在大部分时间里什么也没做。

sentences.en: Am I right?
sentences.zh: 我说的对吗？

sentences.en: He's presumably just doing carpentry.
sentences.zh: 他大概只是在做木匠活。

sentences.en: Well, that's what the gospels imply.
sentences.zh: 嗯，福音书就是这么暗示的。

sentences.en: And that passage from Luke that you read, you know, you have the kind of the more mythical elements, and then suddenly it's being named, it's a specific
sentences.zh: 你读的那段路加福音，你知道的，先是包含了一些更具神话色彩的元素，然后突然就被命名了，这是一个特定的

sentences.en: year, Tiberius, governors, all this, you know, prefects, all this kind of thing, being absolutely nailed down.
sentences.zh: 年份，提比略，总督们，所有这些，你知道的，长官们，所有这类被绝对精确确定的事情。

sentences.en: And suddenly we're into a record that doesn't really seem to be very long, maybe a year, maybe in John's gospel, three years.
sentences.zh: 然后突然我们进入了一段看起来并不算很长的记录，也许是一年，在约翰福音里也许是三年。

sentences.en: And what is Jesus doing in this period?
sentences.zh: 在这期间耶稣在做什么？

sentences.en: Well, he seems to be claiming the role of a prophet, you know, so that's the John the Baptist role.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他似乎在宣称先知的角色，你知道的，这就是施洗约翰的角色。

sentences.en: He's preaching the fact that the day of judgment is coming and that the fruitless tree will be cut down, all that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 他在宣讲审判日将要来临、不结果子的树将被砍倒等诸如此类的事实。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He's a healer.
sentences.zh: 他是一个治病救人者。

sentences.en: So that's a very important aspect of the stories.
sentences.zh: 所以这是这些故事中非常重要的一方面。

sentences.en: And that must be a very, again, just thinking about the stuff that I did when I was at university
sentences.zh: 这一定非常，同样地，想想我在大学时做过的

sentences.en: about holy men in late antiquity, people going around claiming to have powers of various kinds, to be healers, to cast out demons, to exorcise spirits, all these kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 关于晚期古代圣人的研究，人们到处声称拥有各种能力，能治病、驱魔、驱逐邪灵，所有这些类型的事情。

sentences.en: And they're kind of 10 a penny, aren't they?
sentences.zh: 这些家伙多得不值一提，不是吗？

sentences.en: In the Levant, in the ancient world, in the late antique world?
sentences.zh: 在黎凡特，在古代世界，在晚期古代世界？

sentences.en: Not 10 a penny, but certainly, I mean, it's not absolutely unheard of.
sentences.zh: 倒也不是不值一提，但当然，我的意思是，这并非闻所未闻。

sentences.en: There are a lot of people who are doing this.
sentences.zh: 有很多人在做这件事。

sentences.en: So Jesus is, he's healing people, he's exorcising people, he's casting out demons.
sentences.zh: 所以耶稣，他在治愈人们，他在驱魔，他在驱逐邪灵。

sentences.en: And this is all clearly part of his charismatic appeal.
sentences.zh: 而这一切显然都是他个人超凡魅力吸引力的一部分。

sentences.en: What we as sceptical people in the 21st century are to make of it, I think it's the wrong question.
sentences.zh: 我们作为21世纪持怀疑态度的人该如何看待它，我认为这是错误的问题。

sentences.en: I mean, he's in a world where people accept that these things happen.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他身处一个人们接受这些事情会发生的时代。

sentences.en: And whatever it is that he's doing, or that people are imagining about him, his charisma is such as that clearly people think that he has these powers.
sentences.zh: 无论他在做什么，或者人们对他有什么想象，他的个人魅力如此之大，以至于人们显然认为他拥有这些能力。

sentences.en: But Tom, what surely is legitimate to say from the perspective of the 21st century is he's not alone in that.
sentences.zh: 但是汤姆，从21世纪的角度来看，言之有理的是，他在这一点上并不孤单。

sentences.en: That there must have been people over the next hill or three villages away who are doing the same.
sentences.zh: 在翻过山丘或者三个村庄之外，肯定也有人在做同样的事。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: And not just in Palestine.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅在巴勒斯坦。

sentences.en: I mean, this is stuff that's going on across the Roman world.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是整个罗马世界都在发生的事情。

sentences.en: I mean, it wouldn't surprise me if the goal that we mentioned in the beginning of the first similarly kind of performing prodigies of healing or whatever.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果我们提到的我们在开始时说的那个人同样在表现出神迹治病或别的什么，我也不会感到惊讶。

sentences.en: This is something that is happening.
sentences.zh: 这是正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: The idea that charismatic figures are touched by the supernatural and have power is current.
sentences.zh: 具有个人魅力的人物受到超自然力量的触及并拥有力量这种观点是普遍存在的。

sentences.en: Now, the question is, of course, for Jesus's contemporaries in Galilee and Judea is, is this a malevolent power?
sentences.zh: 当然，现在对于耶稣在加利利和犹太地的同时代人来说，问题是：这是一种恶意的力量吗？

sentences.en: Is this a power that is bred, you know, is it demonic, which is what the rabbis over the, you know, the course of late antiquity will teach, that Jesus was a disciple of demons?
sentences.zh: 这是一种滋生的力量，你知道的，它是邪恶的吗？也就是晚期古代的犹太拉比们后来会教导的，说耶稣是恶魔的门徒？

sentences.en: Or is it expressive of what Jesus claims, which is the imminence of the kingdom of God and eschatological, i.e. the idea that the end times are coming?
sentences.zh: 还是它表达了耶稣所声称的东西，即上帝之国的临近以及末世论，也就是末日即将来临的想法？

sentences.en: And that's what Albert Schweitzer argued at the beginning of the 20th century.
sentences.zh: 这就是阿尔伯特·史怀哲在20世纪初所论证的。

sentences.en: And I think he seems to me clearly right.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为他显然是对的。

sentences.en: So eschatology, this is the idea that the world is going to end, that there'll be some sort of apocalypse, that there'll be some kind of...
sentences.zh: 所以末世论，这就是世界将会终结、将会有某种启示录、将会有某种……的想法。

sentences.en: The judgment is coming.
sentences.zh: 审判即将到来。

sentences.en: ...rebirth or whatever.
sentences.zh: ...重生或其他什么。

sentences.en: And why is this so common in this period, so the age of the reign of Augustus?
sentences.zh: 为什么这在这个时期，也就是奥古斯都统治时期如此普遍？

sentences.en: Or is it...
sentences.zh: 还是说……

sentences.en: I don't think it is particularly.
sentences.zh: 我不认为它特别普遍。

sentences.en: Is this absolutely just standard?
sentences.zh: 这完全是标准现象吗？

sentences.en: No, I don't think it is.
sentences.zh: 不，我认为不是。

sentences.en: And I think that that's what makes John the Baptist distinctive.
sentences.zh: 我认为正是这一点让施洗约翰与众不同。

sentences.en: That's what he's preaching.
sentences.zh: 这就是他在宣讲的内容。

sentences.en: And I think that's what makes Jesus distinctive.
sentences.zh: 我认为这也是让耶稣与众不同的地方。

sentences.en: And what makes Jesus even more distinctive is that he is laying claim to the role of the judge in this day of judgment, as far as we can tell.
sentences.zh: 而让耶稣更加与众不同的是，据我们所知，他正在宣称自己在这审判日中扮演审判者的角色。

sentences.en: I mean, that is the implication of the parables.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是那些比喻的含义。

sentences.en: So normally when people tell you the end of the world is nigh, they don't then say, and I will be the person who, you know, divides people into sheep and goats.
sentences.zh: 所以通常当人们告诉你世界末日将近时，他们不会接着说，而我将是那个，你知道的，把人分为绵羊和山羊的人。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: They give that role to somebody more potent than themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们会把这个角色赋予一个比他们自己更有权力的人。

sentences.en: But are you saying Jesus is explicitly saying, and I'm going to be the one who chooses heaven and hell or whatever?
sentences.zh: 但你是说耶稣明确表示，我将是那个选择天堂与地狱或类似事情的人吗？

sentences.en: Well, on the evidence of the Gospels, and of course, you know, they're not gospel.
sentences.zh: 嗯，根据福音书的证据——当然，你知道的，它们并非绝对真理。

sentences.en: But on the evidence of the Gospels, Jesus is constantly provoking confusion.
sentences.zh: 但根据福音书的证据，耶稣不断地引发混乱。

sentences.en: He's provoking confusion among his critics because he's laying claim to all kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 他在他的批评者中引发了混乱，因为他声称拥有各种各样的权力。

sentences.en: And he's doing all kinds of things that Judeans shouldn't do.
sentences.zh: 而且他在做各种犹太人不应该做的事情。

sentences.en: He's hanging out with tax collectors.
sentences.zh: 他和税吏混在一起。

sentences.en: He's hanging out with prostitutes, all this kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 他和妓女混在一起，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: He's hanging out with the lowest of the low.
sentences.zh: 他和社会最底层的人混在一起。

sentences.en: So yeah, but his disciples are also confused.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，但他的门徒也很困惑。

sentences.en: And this is arising from the fact that he is claiming an absolutely unheard of authority.
sentences.zh: 这源于他声称拥有绝对前所未有的权威这一事实。

sentences.en: But the further strangeness is that this authority, so, you know, there is this long tradition going back to the Enlightenment that Jesus was actually a
sentences.zh: 但更怪异的是，这种权威，所以，你知道的，从启蒙运动开始就有一个长期的传统，认为耶稣实际上是一个

sentences.en: freedom fighter, that he was a rebel.
sentences.zh: 自由战士，他是一个叛军。

sentences.en: And in fact, it goes back even beyond the Enlightenment.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这甚至超越了启蒙运动。

sentences.en: It goes back to, so in the time of Diocletian, just before Constantine, there are skeptical pagan
sentences.zh: 它甚至可以追溯到，在戴克里先时期，就在君士坦丁之前，有一些持怀疑态度的异教

sentences.en: philosophers who are saying that Jesus was a rebel, that he took to the hills, that he was a kind of bandit at the head of rebels.
sentences.zh: 哲学家说耶稣是一个叛军，他占领了山区，他是叛军头目中的某种强盗。

sentences.en: So that is a tradition.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个传统。

sentences.en: But based on the evidence of the
sentences.zh: 但根据

sentences.en: Gospels, this is not the case at all.
sentences.zh: 福音书的证据，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: And had Jesus been a rebel, again, it's hard to see why he would have been enshrined as Christian tradition enshrines him.
sentences.zh: 如果耶稣是个叛军，同样地，很难看出他为什么会被基督教传统所供奉的那样供奉起来。

sentences.en: The Gospel writers, Paul, the people who exist before Paul, because the one thing that you get again and again and again throughout the
sentences.zh: 福音书的作者们，保罗，在保罗之前存在的人们，因为你在

sentences.en: Gospels is that Jesus is proclaiming what he calls the kingdom of God.
sentences.zh: 福音书中一遍又一遍看到的一件事是，耶稣在宣扬他所谓的上帝之国。

sentences.en: And this kingdom is not one that is founded in military exploits.
sentences.zh: 而这个国度不是建立在军事功绩之上的。

sentences.en: It's not one that is founded in the kind of the appurtenances of power.
sentences.zh: 它不是建立在权力的种种外在表象之上的。

sentences.en: So what Jesus is doing is he's announcing the presence, the imminence, the near arrival of a kingdom that has no political substance whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 所以耶稣在做的是，他在宣告一个毫无政治实质的国度的存在、迫近、即将来临。

sentences.en: And its authority is something that can be felt in the heart.
sentences.zh: 而它的权威是可以在心中感受到的。

sentences.en: It can't be experienced as something that is upheld by soldiers or courts or laws or judges or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 它不能被体验为一种由士兵、法庭、法律、法官或任何类似东西维系的事物。

sentences.en: So basically what he's doing, he is preaching the idea of a kingdom of virtue.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上他在做的是，他在宣讲美德之国的理念。

sentences.en: And this is such a momentous idea.
sentences.zh: 这是一个如此重大的理念。

sentences.en: We live with the effects of that in 2022.
sentences.zh: 我们在2022年依然生活在它的影响之下。

sentences.en: This idea that there is a kingdom of virtue that transcends the churn of politics.
sentences.zh: 这种认为存在一个超越政治风云变幻的美德之国的理念。

sentences.en: It's such a potent idea.
sentences.zh: 这是一个如此强有力的理念。

sentences.en: And if it doesn't come from Jesus, then where does it come from?
sentences.zh: 如果它不是来自耶稣，那它又是从何而来？

sentences.en: Are the Gospel writers just making it up?
sentences.zh: 福音书的作者们是在凭空捏造吗？

sentences.en: I mean, it seems improbable.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这似乎不太可能。

sentences.en: And so the likeliest explanation, as far as I'm concerned, is that it does derive from Jesus, you know, on the principle of Occam's razor.
sentences.zh: 因此在我看来，最合理的解释是，它确实源自耶稣，你知道的，本着奥卡姆剃刀的原则。

sentences.en: He isn't drawing on something, I don't know, all kinds of strands and traditions that are around in the first century AD.
sentences.zh: 他并非借鉴了某种，我不知道，公元一世纪时各种流传的线索和传统。

sentences.en: He is.
sentences.zh: 他是。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: I mean, he's deeply steep in scripture.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他对经文有着极深的造诣。

sentences.en: Of course he is.
sentences.zh: 他当然有。

sentences.en: But he is, I don't know, he's
sentences.zh: 但他是，我不知道，他是

sentences.en: laying claim that he's going to sit in judgment, that he is going to preside over the kingdom of God.
sentences.zh: 声称他将要参与审判，他将要主宰上帝的国度。

sentences.en: And again, I think it goes back to this idea that I talked about at the very end of the previous
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我认为这可以追溯到我在上一集

sentences.en: episode, this idea that he is situated between the dimension of the temple and the temple authorities
sentences.zh: 末尾谈到的这个观点，即他处于圣殿维度与圣殿当局

sentences.en: and all that kind of stuff, and the kind of the Roman world of supernatural power.
sentences.zh: 以及所有这类事物，和罗马超自然力量的世界之间。

sentences.en: And he is saying that he is emancipating himself and those who follow him from those dimensions, because I think
sentences.zh: 他在说，他正在把自己和追随者从这些维度中解放出来，因为我认为

sentences.en: he sees the supernatural dimension of the temple, let alone the supernatural dimension of Roman power, as being too much a part of the world.
sentences.zh: 他将圣殿的超自然维度，更不用说罗马权力的超自然维度，视为这个世界过于沉重的一部分。

sentences.en: And the kingdom of God is not, in that sense, you know, when he comes before Pilate and he says, my kingdom is not of this world.
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，上帝的国度不是，你知道的，当他来到彼拉多面前说，我的国不属这个世界。

sentences.en: That's what he's meaning.
sentences.zh: 这就是他的意思。

sentences.en: But it's something that in the context of, you know, the world that he is in, is experienced as something strange and kind of unfathomable, and yet also incredibly powerful.
sentences.zh: 但这是在，你知道的，他所处的那个世界的背景下，被体验为一种奇怪、不可捉摸，却又强大得不可思议的事物。

sentences.en: And that, I think, is the key of why he gets the followers that he does, and why he's commemorated in the way that he is.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这就是他为什么能拥有追随者，以及他为什么会被那样纪念的关键所在。

sentences.en: So there are two elements I want to ask about, Tom, before we go to a break.
sentences.zh: 所以在我们休息之前，汤姆，我有两个问题想问你。

sentences.en: Number one follows on from what you've been saying.
sentences.zh: 第一点承接你刚才所说的话。

sentences.en: So in the first podcast, you were talking about the context of Galilee in the first century AD, and about what I rather
sentences.zh: 所以在第一期播客中，你谈到了公元一世纪加利利的历史背景，以及我有些

sentences.en: tritely called a kind of emerging culture war between people who liked Roman pots and metropolitan things like you, and people like me who were earthy, authentic, salt of the earth
sentences.zh: 陈腐地称之为喜欢罗马陶器和大都市事物的精英们，与像我这样朴实、地道、脚踏实地的普通人之间

sentences.en: kind of people.
sentences.zh: 这种正在萌芽的文化冲突。

sentences.en: And the way you're describing Jesus there, he's appealing to people at the bottom.
sentences.zh: 而你对耶稣的描述，他是在吸引底层的人。

sentences.en: He's saying there'll be a kingdom that is not one of power and wealth and all that sort of
sentences.zh: 他在说，会有一个国度，它不属于权力和财富之类

sentences.en: The last shall be first, and the first shall be laSt.
sentences.zh: 在后的将要在前，在前的将要在后。

sentences.en: Precisely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So there are people who've written about him, kind of biographers and people exploring the historical Jesus who've seen him as a kind of, dare I say, a kind of proto-socialist,
sentences.zh: 所以有些人写过关于他的书，比如传记作家和探索历史中耶稣的人，他们把他看作某种，我敢说，某种原始社会主义者，

sentences.en: a kind of social radical, a prophet of social change.
sentences.zh: 某种社会激进派，社会变革的先知。

sentences.en: Is that at all reasonable?
sentences.zh: 这有任何合理性吗？

sentences.en: The kingdom of God is not of this earth.
sentences.zh: 上帝的国度不属于这个世界。

sentences.en: So he's not a socialist in that sense.
sentences.zh: 所以从这个意义上说，他不是社会主义者。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's preaching something stranger.
sentences.zh: 他宣讲的是更奇特的东西。

sentences.en: He's preaching the idea that in some way, the just will be rewarded, the hungry will be fed, the thirsty will get water, and the last shall be first, and the first shall be laSt.
sentences.zh: 他宣讲的是这样一种观念：在某种程度上，义人将得到奖赏，饥饿的将得到饱足，干渴的将得到水，并且在后的将要在前，在前的将要在后。

sentences.en: Tom, you'd be a great vicar.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，你会是个伟大的牧师。

sentences.en: You're such a loss to the vicaring profession.
sentences.zh: 牧师这个行业失去你真是太可惜了。

sentences.en: And the strangeness of it, I think, is what leads him to be put to death, because he is seen as a
sentences.zh: 而这种奇特性，我认为，正是导致他被处死的原因，因为他被 Judean（犹太）圣殿当局

sentences.en: menacing figure by both the Judean temple authorities and in the due course by the Romans, because he's
sentences.zh: 和随后的罗马人视为一个具有威胁的人物，因为他

sentences.en: attacking the claims to divine authority of both the temple priesthood and of Pilate as Caesar's representative.
sentences.zh: 攻击了圣殿祭司阶层和作为凯撒代表的彼拉多两者的神圣权威主张。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But he is still appealing to people who are not normally appealed to, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 但他仍然在吸引那些通常不会被吸引的人，对吧？

sentences.en: He is.
sentences.zh: 他是的。

sentences.en: You know, prostitutes, tax collectors, whatever.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，妓女、税吏等等。

sentences.en: Yes, he is.
sentences.zh: 是的，他是。

sentences.en: He is.
sentences.zh: 他是的。

sentences.en: I mean, so the kingdom of heaven manifests itself in all kinds of subversions.
sentences.zh: 我是说，所以天国在各种颠覆中彰显自身。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So he is a subversive.
sentences.zh: 所以他是一个颠覆者。

sentences.en: He's a very subversive.
sentences.zh: 他是一个非常颠覆的人。

sentences.en: He's a very subversive figure.
sentences.zh: 他是一个非常颠覆的人物。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He's an incredibly subversive figure.
sentences.zh: 他是一个极其颠覆的人物。

sentences.en: Now, my second question slightly cuts against that.
sentences.zh: 现在，我的第二个问题与此略有冲突。

sentences.en: Is he the Jewish Messiah?
sentences.zh: 他是犹太人的弥赛亚吗？

sentences.en: So there is this idea, isn't there, rooted within the sort of Jewish, or maybe you would say Judean, prophetic
sentences.zh: 所以有这样一种观点，不是吗，根植于犹太，或者也许你会说是 Judean（犹太）的先知

sentences.en: tradition that a king, a descendant of David will arise and lead, you know, the children of Israel to who knows what, some new golden age.
sentences.zh: 传统中，一个君王，大卫的后裔将会兴起并引领，你知道的，以色列的儿女走向谁知道呢，某个新的黄金时代。

sentences.en: Is he consciously laying claim to that?
sentences.zh: 他是在有意识地宣称这一点吗？

sentences.en: I think he is, because I think that it's very difficult to understand otherwise why the Romans would have crucified him.
sentences.zh: 我认为他是的，因为我认为很难否则去理解为什么罗马人会把他钉死在十字架上。

sentences.en: And it's also very difficult to understand why after his death, his followers would have enshrined him as the Messiah, would have thought of him as the Messiah,
sentences.zh: 而且也很难理解为什么在他死后，他的追随社会会把他奉为弥赛亚，会认为他是弥赛亚，

sentences.en: because, you know, I mean, okay, so they think he's risen from the dead.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，好吧，所以他们认为他从死里复活了。

sentences.en: That in itself would not be sufficient to make it obvious that he's the Messiah.
sentences.zh: 这本身还不足以让人明显看出他是弥赛亚。

sentences.en: So I think that all the evidence suggests that Jesus must have laid claim to that.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为所有的证据都表明耶稣一定宣称过这一点。

sentences.en: And the whole thing about him entering Jerusalem, say, on the donkey, all that kind of stuff suggests, but this is, I think, part of what he's teaching.
sentences.zh: 他骑着驴进入耶路撒冷等等整件事情都暗示了这一点，但这我认为正是他教导的一部分。

sentences.en: So we are going to come to a break in a second, but just before, you were talking a little bit
sentences.zh: 所以我们马上就要休息一下，但在那之前，你刚才

sentences.en: earlier about this thing about whether or not he's a freedom fighter, a bandit who takes to the hills or whatever.
sentences.zh: 谈到过他是否是一个自由战士，一个逃入山中的强盗之类的话题。

sentences.en: But if he is proclaiming himself the Jewish Messiah, that is an explicitly political claim, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 但如果他宣称自己是犹太人的弥赛亚，那这是一个明确的政治主张，对吧？

sentences.en: It's not just a kind of theological supernatural claim.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是一种神学的超自然主张。

sentences.en: We go back to the strangeness of this idea of the kingdom of God, that he is situating the kingdom of
sentences.zh: 我们回溯到上帝之国这个概念的奇特性，即他将上帝之国置于

sentences.en: God beyond the dimensions of, as he sees it, earthly kingdom.
sentences.zh: 在他看来超越世俗王权维度的领域。

sentences.en: So, you know, he goes to the temple and in the synoptic accounts, it's after that, that he's brought this question by the Pharisees who are trying to trip him up.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，他去了圣殿，在对观福音的记载中，正是在那之后，试图陷害他的法利赛人向他提出了这个问题。

sentences.en: Should we pay taxes to Caesar?
sentences.zh: 我们该向凯撒缴纳税款吗？

sentences.en: And he asks for a coin and he can do this because in Galilee, there are no Roman coins, but in Judea there are.
sentences.zh: 他要了一枚硬币，他能这样做是因为在加利利没有罗马硬币，但在犹太地区有。

sentences.en: And he's shown the coin and he says, whose head is that?
sentences.zh: 有人把硬币拿给他看，他说，这是谁的头像？

sentences.en: And the Pharisee replies, Caesar.
sentences.zh: 法利赛人回答说，凯撒的。

sentences.en: And so he famously replies, render unto Caesar what is Caesar's and render unto God what is God.
sentences.zh: 于是他给出了那句名言：凯撒的物当归给凯撒，神的物当归给神。

sentences.en: And this is, it's a brilliant
sentences.zh: 这是一个，这是一个绝妙的

sentences.en: riposte, but it's also an acorn from which a mighty oak will grow.
sentences.zh: 回击，但它也是一粒将长成参天大树的橡果。

sentences.en: It's, and that oak is, you know, is the secular tradition that we inhabit.
sentences.zh: 它，那棵橡果就是，你知道的，我们所身处的世俗传统。

sentences.en: I was about to say, that oak is your book dominion, Tom, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 我正想说，那棵橡果就是你的书《多米尼恩》，汤姆，对吧？

sentences.en: Pretty much, pretty much.
sentences.zh: 差不多，差不多。

sentences.en: And, and this is a kind of, you know, this is an incredibly radical, subversive, and yet poetic teaching.
sentences.zh: 而且，这是一种，你知道的，这是一种极其激进、颠覆，却又极具诗意的教导。

sentences.en: It's not the teaching of, of a revolutionary.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个革命者的教导。

sentences.en: It's not the teacher of someone who is raising the sword against the Romans or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个向罗马人或其他什么人举起刀剑的人的教导。

sentences.en: But it is the teaching of someone whose concept of a kingdom that transcends earthly power will have this
sentences.zh: 但这是一个人的教导，他对超越世俗权力的国度的概念将产生

sentences.en: stupefying, I mean, kind of an impact so profound that it's almost impossible to measure.
sentences.zh: 震撼性的，我是说，一种深远到几乎无法衡量的巨大影响。

sentences.en: It's impact has been so overwhelming that we don't even recognise it for what it is.
sentences.zh: 它的影响如此压倒性，以至于我们甚至没有认出它原本的面貌。

sentences.en: And this is where it begins.
sentences.zh: 而这一切就从这里开始。

sentences.en: To play the sceptic again, though, Tom, is it not possible that that would, that is a detail
sentences.zh: 不过，为了再次扮演怀疑论者，汤姆，难道没有可能那是

sentences.en: inserted later on, precisely because the early Christians want this creed to thrive in the
sentences.zh: 后来加入的细节，恰恰是因为早期的基督徒希望这种信仰在

sentences.en: Roman world.
